title: Prism Seed
theme: A tiny glowing prism creature in a deep crystal cavern launches glowing seeds to charge floating crystal targets before the light fades.
mechanics: Click-drag from the prism to aim a projectile with direction and power
Release to fire a seed along a ballistic arc under gravity
Preview the trajectory with dotted ghost markers before firing
Charge floating crystal targets by seeding them directly
Bounce seeds off crystal walls to reach targets behind cover
Charge every target before running out of seeds
Five hand-authored levels with more targets and tighter seed budgets
